summary: Iteration 17 tested branch holidays (add rules, clash rules, list/can_edit, delete), branch-aware reports and leave day counts, the 8am missed-checkout digest cron, and the Holidays/Leave UI. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass. A probe checked the digest message per manager, with push mocked. Admin: branches [] creates a company-wide holiday; chosen branches are stored sorted; an unknown branch gets 400. Sub-admin (managed_sites ['Bengaluru HQ']): no branches 400; Tumkur Yard 403; mixed own+other 403; own branch 200. A throwaway sub-admin with no managed_sites gets 403. Employee gets 403. Clash rules: company-wide vs anything on the same date 400; branch vs company-wide 400; overlapping branch 400 (the message names the clashing branch); Tumkur Yard and Bengaluru HQ on the same date both OK. GET /holidays: admin can_edit is true for all. Sub-admin can_edit is true only for Bengaluru HQ-only holidays (false for company-wide, Tumkur Yard and BH+TY). Ravi sees company-wide, BH and BH+TY, not TY-only. Sub-admin DELETE of company/TY/mixed holidays 403; own 200; employee 403; unknown id 404. Reports for 2026-11-10..11 with a TY holiday on the 10th and a BH holiday on the 11th: Ravi went from holiday 0/absent 2 to 1/1; Anita (GeoTest HQ) stayed 0/2. Ravi leave 2027-06-07..10 with a TY holiday on the 8th and a BH holiday on the 9th gave days=3. A single-day leave on a BH holiday gets 400. Cron: no auth 401, wrong bearer 401. First call {ok, queued:<today>}, second call {ok, duplicate:true}, JSON-array body 400. cron_runs status done with missed=1 after seeding a throwaway auto_closed 'missed checkout' record for yesterday. Probe with mocked push: the admin got '2 missed check-out Thu 01 Jan' (Anita, Ravi); the sub-admin got '1 missed check-out' (Ravi only, scope correct); with no records both got 'All clear for Thu 01 Jan'. UI (/admin#calendar): admin sees chips holiday-branch-all, Bengaluru HQ, GeoTest HQ and Tumkur Yard. Adding a TY+GeoTest holiday shows the 'added' toast and the scope 'GeoTest HQ, Tumkur Yard'. Delete via confirm works. The clash error toast shows. Sub-admin (fresh session) sees only the Bengaluru HQ chip and no Whole company option. Delete buttons show only on BH holidays. 'Pick at least one of your branches' toast shows when adding with no branch. A sub-admin add and delete on their own branch works. The Ravi /leave upcoming-holidays list shows the BH holiday and hides the TY holiday. No push_subscriptions exist in the DB, so no real notifications were sent. All test data was cleaned up.

minor.issue: Deleting a branch does not $pull it from holidays.branches (rename does update it). Orphan branch holidays then apply to nobody, and sub-admins can no longer edit a mixed holiday. Suggest db.holidays.update_many({branches:name},{$pull:{branches:name}}) and deleting docs left with an empty branches list, so they don't silently become company-wide.

Uses {check_out: None} for yesterday. A night-shift worker who checked in yesterday and is legitimately still on duty at 8am (if session_cap has not passed) would be listed as 'missed check-out'. Edge case only.
auto_close_stale_sessions() is awaited before the 2xx ack. That goes against the 'ack immediately' comment and could be slow with many open sessions. Move it into the background task.

issues: Uses the native <input type=date> and a native <select> for the year instead of the shadcn Calendar/Select used elsewhere in the design system
Card is capped at max-w-3xl on a 1920px screen, which leaves most of the page empty (cosmetic)

Optional: move auto_close_stale_sessions into the background task of the digest cron
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3278 lines. Split it into routers (holidays, cron, reports, leave).
The count_leave_days error message 'Those dates are already company holidays' is shown for branch holidays as well. Reword it to 'already holidays for your branch'.
A half-day leave on a holiday date is not rejected (count_leave_days returns 0.5 before the holiday check). This was already there before this change.

The cron_runs key missed-digest-2026-11-24 was deleted and recreated by the test (now done, missed=1). Pre-existing leftover holiday TEST_Eve (2026-12-24) is not mine and was left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported and -p no:xdist. When switching roles in Playwright, clear localStorage/cookies or use a fresh page. Swapping cookies in the same SPA once showed a stale admin header. The DB has no push_subscriptions, so digest delivery was only verified with the probe (push mocked). Server date is 2026-11-24.
